entries.title: Enforce query-mode causal direction for RECOVERY and COUNTERFACTUAL

entries.description: The first strong-baseline resource run reused cached query embeddings, and the hybrid timing reused a dense ranking computed by the preceding arm. Retrieval rankings and quality metrics were valid, but the latency comparison was warm-cache and therefore not a fair per-arm query-cost measurement.

post_fix.cost_policy: Each dense, hybrid and CT-RAG arm invalidates the exact query embedding before its timed block; hybrid recomputes dense retrieval inside its own timed block. Document embeddings remain indexed.
post_fix.quality_impact: none; dev retrieval rankings and aggregate quality metrics are unchanged

pre_fix.cost_policy: Query embedding/dense work could be reused from an earlier arm through the benchmark cache, producing invalid warm-cache latency values for cross-arm comparison.
pre_fix.quality_impact: none; defect affected only resource timing

entries.title: Measure learned retrieval arms with independent cold query embeddings
